title: Manifest naming and format stability
description: Why a project has two files at its root with opposite purposes.
body: Two things sit at the root: <name>.kaava is what the project is (identity and metadata), and .kaava/ is what OpenKaava produced (traces, designs, docs). They cannot share a name — one directory cannot hold both a file and a folder with the same name — so the manifest takes the project's own name. A file from a newer OpenKaava still opens here through forward-compatible loading.
